target: All Clear, Angry Hit, Arm Crash, Audacious Laugh
policy: Promote only mechanics directly supported by current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation or corroborating status/mentor references; retain source-reported numeric values as bounded evidence and do not infer frame data, hidden gates, or probabilities.

records.name: All Clear

supported_fields.mechanics: 100-Ki Strike Super. The user swings an arm to create a frontal sweeping energy wave that knocks the opponent away and can negate Ki Waves. The move can also be used while guarding; current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence describes the guard use as invulnerable for the duration. Source-reported damage is about 10% and is not treated as patch-independent.

limits: ~10% damage is source-reported and not asserted as patch-independent.
No exact guard timing/frame data or hidden prerequisite inferred.

records.name: Angry Hit

supported_fields.mechanics: 100-Ki Strike Super. The user teleports toward the targeted opponent and strikes them with both fists, knocking them down. Current Xenoverse 2-specific skill evidence describes the move as a single-hit, mid-range teleport attack with source-reported damage of about 20%.

limits: ~20% damage is source-reported and not asserted as patch-independent.

records.name: Arm Crash

supported_fields.mechanics: 100-Ki Strike Super. The user pulls the right arm back and rushes forward with a lariat that breaks an opponent's guard on contact. Holding the input extends travel to about 1.5 times the base distance. Current skill documentation reports about 20% damage; the value is retained as source-reported rather than universal.

limits: ~20% damage is source-reported and not asserted as patch-independent.
1.5x charge-distance statement is retained as documented behavior; no frame data inferred.

records.name: Audacious Laugh

supported_fields.mechanics: 100-Ki Other Super. The user laughs while a dark red-orange aura surrounds them; after a short delay the locked-on opponent is staggered and receives a movement-speed slowdown. The move is non-damaging and requires lock-on to an enemy.

limits: No exact delay/duration for slowdown is promoted.
No damage or hidden condition is inferred.
